title: LbVserverServiceBinding
description: Binding between a load balancing virtual server and a backend service. This allows the virtual server to distribute traffic to the bound service.

name.description: Name of the load balancing virtual server to which the service is bound.

servicename.description: Name of the service to bind to the virtual server.

weight.description: Weight assigned to the service for weighted load balancing. Range 1-100.

servicetype.description: Protocol type of the bound service.

curstate.description: Current state of the bound service.

ipv46.description: IP address of the bound service.

dynamicweight.description: Dynamic weight of the service based on server health.
